Thanks team — a couple of practical notes from the SE side to help pick a time: we need ~90 minutes (planning + live tracing + Q&A). Ideally Soojin (me) and one other engineer join the call for the tracing demo.

Quick overlap analysis (UTC and local on the week of Mar 29):
- Option A (12:00–13:30 UTC) => US East (EDT) 08:00–09:30, UK (GMT/BST) 12:00–13:30 (note: shifts to 13:00–14:30 BST after Mar 28 if scheduled the week of Mar 29), JST 21:00–22:30, IST 17:30–19:00.
- Option B (14:00–15:30 UTC) => better for UK/US morning, poor for JST (23:00+).
- Option C (05:00–06:30 UTC) => good for APAC midday, terrible for US East.

Given constraints, my recommendation:
- Primary: single 90-minute slot on Option A but start 30 minutes earlier to avoid JST late-night pressure: PROPOSED FINAL: 11:30–13:00 UTC (EDT 07:30–09:00, GMT 11:30–13:00, JST 20:30–22:00). This keeps Japan finishing by 22:00 and moves US to earlier morning.
- Fallback: split into two 60-minute sessions (APAC+EU day 1; EU+US day 2) if any participant absolutely cannot do evening JST.

I've uploaded a small overlap grid to the Google sheet (see link) and attached an .ics stub (proposed-times.ics) you can use as a starting invite.
